h1: Lertnimit Hotel Chaiyaphum — an old hotel in the city centre with renovated rooms, at budget prices
intro: If you come to Chaiyaphum and want a place right in the city centre, within walking distance of the market, restaurants and the shopping area, without spending much — Lertnimit Hotel is a long-established hotel that locals know well. It sits in the centre near the Phaya Lae Monument, offers several room grades, and has renovated some of its rooms. What reviews praise most often is the friendly service and the easy-walk location, plus free parking and free Wi-Fi, with rates from about ฿650/night. The trade-off is that it is an older building, the original and renovated rooms differ noticeably, and being on a central road means some street noise reaches the front-facing rooms.

body.html: What guests at Lertnimit Hotel talk about most is the friendly service and the central location. Many reviews agree that the staff are warm and helpful, check-in is easy, and the hotel really is in the middle of town, so it is a short walk out to the market or a local restaurant. It is a long-established Chaiyaphum hotel that has been open for years and has gradually renovated its rooms, so there is a mix of older and updated rooms to choose from.

Location is the main strength — right in central Chaiyaphum, close to the Phaya Lae Monument, the market and the shopping streets. That suits people here for work or errands as well as travellers who want a city-centre base before heading out to Tat Ton Waterfall or the Siam tulip fields. There is free on-site parking, which is convenient if you drive in yourself and don't want to hunt for a space.

Rooms come in several grades, from Standard up to Junior Suite and Suite. Each room has air conditioning, a TV, a fridge and hot water. The renovated rooms are praised as clean and fresher than expected for the price. If you want a room in good shape, it's worth asking specifically for a renovated room or going for a higher grade, because the older and newer rooms differ quite a bit in both condition and decor.
"The staff were really lovely — very impressed. Clean room, right in the centre so you can walk to the market, and good value for a budget rate."

To be straight about it, the limits here are that it is an older building and the original rooms differ clearly from the renovated ones. Some reviews found a room that looked older than expected, so asking for a renovated room when you book helps a lot. The other recurring point is that the shower water pressure is on the weak side in some rooms, and because it sits on a central road, some traffic or street noise carries into the front-facing rooms.

One more thing worth knowing: the hotel is near the city's restaurant and nightlife strip, which is handy if you want to head out for an evening meal or a drink, but it can also mean some noise on weekend nights for light sleepers. If you want quiet, ask for an inner room or a floor further from the road. Wi-Fi works in the rooms and common areas, and while staff speak limited English, it is no problem for Thai travellers.

Overall, Lertnimit Hotel earns about 7.9 out of 10 from real reviews, which is solid for an older budget hotel in the heart of town. It suits people who value a central location, walking to the market and restaurants, and free parking on a tight budget, and who don't mind whether the building is old or new. Rates start around ฿650 and rise with the season and room type. Book a renovated room and pick one further from the road, and you get a genuinely good-value city-centre stay of a kind that isn't easy to find in Chaiyaphum.

The trade-off is an older building where the original and renovated rooms differ clearly, and a central-road position that brings some noise to certain rooms.

faq.q: Where is Lertnimit Hotel in Chaiyaphum, and what is nearby?
faq.a: Lertnimit Hotel is right in central Chaiyaphum, in Nai Mueang, Mueang Chaiyaphum District. It's near the Phaya Lae Monument, the market and the shopping streets, so you can walk out for food. Tat Ton Waterfall is about a 30-minute drive — a good city-centre base.

faq.q: What are the room rates at Lertnimit Hotel, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Rates start at about ฿650/night for a Standard room. There are several grades — Standard, Suite, Junior Suite and renovated rooms — each with AC, TV, fridge and hot water. Prices vary with the season and room type, so compare a few platforms before you book.

faq.q: Does Lertnimit Hotel have parking and Wi-Fi?
faq.a: Yes, both. There is free parking and free Wi-Fi in the rooms and common areas. It suits self-drivers, and being central means you don't have to look far for a space.

faq.q: What are the rooms like at Lertnimit Hotel?
faq.a: It is an older hotel that has gradually renovated its rooms, so there is a mix of older and updated rooms. The renovated rooms are praised as clean and fresh, with AC, TV, fridge and hot water. It's worth asking specifically for a renovated room when you book to get one in better shape.

Because it is on a central road and near the restaurant area, front-facing rooms can pick up some traffic or street noise, especially on weekend nights. If you sleep lightly, ask for an inner room or a floor further from the road for more quiet.

faq.q: Who is Lertnimit Hotel best for?
faq.a: It suits people who value a central location, walking to the market and restaurants, and free parking on a budget — whether here for work, errands or sightseeing. If you want a pool or a resort feel, consider Siam River Resort instead.
